title: β-Caryophyllene in hypoxic UFH-001: raw-read reprocessing and two count-based dose contrasts
question: Which metabolic and signaling responses to terpene exposure are reproducible, and which depend on cellular context or a specific target?

claims.text: GSE125511 labels three UFH-001 DMSO controls, three 20 µM β-caryophyllene libraries, and three 200 µM β-caryophyllene libraries after 16 hours at 1% oxygen. The three controls are reused from GSE123856.
claims.limitation: The reused controls are one shared comparison group, not an independent cohort; no normoxic treated arm exists.

claims.text: Nine checksum-verified SRA archives were converted to FASTQ and aligned to GENCODE v48 GRCh38. Per-library unique mapping ranges from 87.59% to 89.30%; the unstranded count matrix contains 78,894 genes.
claims.limitation: Mapping quality does not establish independent biological replication or rule out batch effects.

claims.text: The prespecified three-arm PyDESeq2 count model tests 14,312 genes at 20 µM and 14,312 at 200 µM against the same three DMSO controls. BH-adjusted p < 0.05 occurs for 0 and 139 genes, respectively; 0 and 40 also have absolute log2 fold change at least one.
claims.limitation: The two dose contrasts share controls. These are within-study model estimates, not two independent replications or a pathway test.

claims.text: Prespecified cholesterol marker HMGCR: HMGCR log2 fold change -0.119, BH-adjusted p 1 at 20 µM; HMGCR log2 fold change +1.543, BH-adjusted p 1.74e-07 at 200 µM.
claims.limitation: HMGCR transcript abundance is not cholesterol synthesis flux, enzyme activity, or direct β-caryophyllene binding.

claims.text: Prespecified signaling marker PGF: PGF log2 fold change -0.905, BH-adjusted p 1 at 20 µM; PGF log2 fold change -0.525, BH-adjusted p unavailable at 200 µM.
claims.limitation: Dose, time, oxygen, vehicle, and cell identity differ from HepG2; these estimates alone cannot isolate a cell-context interaction.

claims.text: The source article reports a cholesterol-biosynthesis response and altered β-caryophyllene sensitivity after HMGCR inhibition.
claims.limitation: This count-model notebook does not reproduce the intervention experiment or establish direct ligand binding.

claims.text: Follow the separately executed HepG2–UFH-001 cross-context comparison with a matched factorial experiment using shared vehicle, oxygen, dose, time, viability controls, biological replicates, and HMGCR or PGF perturbations.
claims.limitation: The completed cross-study comparison is descriptive while experimental conditions differ; a target-specific interaction requires direct genetic or biochemical evidence.
